sections.name: crew timing tower (tower)
sections.title: Tower ranking rules
sections.what: Checks weeks start on Monday at midnight UTC. Checks members are ranked by read rating, with calls this week, recent form and change since the week began shown, and ties ordered by name. Checks the form shows only the last five calls.
sections.why: Likely reason: a fixed week and ordering make the leaderboard fair and repeatable.
sections.watch_out: Weeks are measured in UTC, so the change appears at a different local time for users far from UTC.

summary: Tests the crew timing tower: how members are ranked by rating, weekly calls, recent form and position change, and when a week starts.
purpose: Makes sure the weekly leaderboard ranks people correctly and shows honest form and change figures.
why: Likely reason: the tower shows a ranking that users compare, so ordering rules must be fixed and clear.
how: Checks a week starts on Monday at midnight UTC. Then builds synthetic call histories for three members and checks ranks, names, rating, change since the week began, calls this week, form and calibration. Also checks form shows only the last five calls and that ties are sorted by name.
inputs: Synthetic call histories with lock times and review results, and a fixed current time.
outputs: Ranked rows with rank, name, read rating, change, calls this week, form and calibration.
risks: The week is set in UTC, so a user far from UTC may see the change at an unexpected local time. Field names in the fake calls must match real review data.
debug: Check the lock times and the week start. Compare the rating before and after each call with the expected change.
